turns.question: Which return reason accounted for the largest share of the returned amount for returns dated between 1 and 4 October 2026, and what was that share?
turns.answer: Damaged goods was the largest return reason by returned amount, at 12.50 EUR of the 24.75 EUR returned for returns dated 1 to 4 October 2026 (late delivery 7.25 EUR, wrong size 5.00 EUR); the semantic layer has no metric for a share of returned amount, so I can't give that percentage (its closest metric, damaged-return share, counts returns on the order date and gives 33.3 % for the same days, a different measure).
